content:
maddy: Heads-up — saw a spike in validator.soft_coercion for fncall responses this morning. Lots of array->object coercions routing to the degen path. Anyone know why we're silently coercing instead of surfacing?

leo: Which route/model? user-facing or internal tool calls?

maddy: Route assistant.tools.v2 on prod-us-east, model redwood-v1-std. Customer sandbox traffic returning `items: ["a"]` vs expected `items: {name:string}`. Validator coerces to avoid adapter failures.

sam: We added soft-coercion intentionally for backwards compat in validator lib, but the console has zero visibility for it — only rejects show up.

console-bot: Alert: validation.coercion rate +6x last 2h on assistant.tools.v2 (sample traces attached).

dina: Paste an example payload?

maddy: Example: {"tool_response": {"items": ["ok"]}} // validator turned into {"items": {"name": "ok"}}

amy: That hides schema drift. Proposed: 1) surface coercions in console per-route, 2) sample raw payloads when coercion happens (opt-in), 3) add telemetry tag coercion_reason so alerts are actionable.

leo: Tagging SGTM. Also think through billing: coerced calls are currently billed as successes. Should we flag them in billing export?

sam: Proposal: keep billing as-is, but export a daily flag `validation_coercion` for reconciliation.

dina: For rollouts, enabling strict validation needs a canary that shows coercion counts + samples in the rollout UI; otherwise will break silently.

maddy: Ops alarm idea: when coercions > X% of invokes for 15m, create ticket + attach sampled trace.

leo: Implementation: emit event validation.coercion from validate_and_normalize() with fields route, model_variant, coercion_type, coercion_reason, trace_id, sampled_payload_id(optional). Make sampling <1% and redact by default.

sam: I'll add metric validation.coercion.count with dimensions and a sampling hook to write redacted payloads to S3 for opted-in projects.

amy: Console: add a small card on route detail with timeline: Rejects / Coercions / Soft-fallbacks + toggle to show samples (requires opt-in). Add privacy copy.

dina: Owners? I'll take the dashboard card. @leo you own event emission/schema. @sam update validator lib and sampling.

leo: Timeline: event contract PR EOD Thu, sampling impl by Tues, dashboard prototype Wed.

sam: Note: follow-up RFC to decide whether coercions count against graceful-fallback SLOs.

dina: Creating ticket ENG-9123 and adding owners.

maddy: Thanks — ping #eng-platform when PRs land. :thumbsup:
